name: Emerald 3D battle models
description: Pokemon Stadium 2 model importer for Emerald: serves the 3D Pokemon models (and Colosseum models #252-386) that Battle Art places in its battles.

required_imports.name: Pokemon Stadium 2 (USA or Europe) ROM
required_imports.description: Required source ROM for Stadium 2 model extraction. .z64, .v64, and .n64 sources are accepted and normalized by the engine.
